messages:
Alex: hey team — Alex here (infra), day 4. Im blocked by a 403 when trying to view a prod flag audit in Console: GET /admin/flags/payments-v2. who should i ping for a short-lived read or a JIT?

Jordan: welcome @Alex :wave: prod read-only access is via ff-auditors. toggles are locked to ff-operators. do you just need to view audits or run a quick toggle?

Alex: only need to view audit entries and recent state to correlate with a customer report. if possible, a 1-hour read window is ideal so I can script the snapshot.

Priya: we prefer JIT for one-offs. please open a Linear ticket with purpose and owner, then ping me and i'll sponsor. ops-bot will create the JIT request.

Alex: filed ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-7888 — purpose: snapshot prod flag & audit for payments-v2 to debug customer fail. expiry requested: 1 hour.

ops-bot: JIT request created: JIT-7888 by Alex. Approver: Priya. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-7888

Priya: approving now. note: approval includes MFA step and will log audit id. paste the exact curl you ran so we can reproduce the 403 if anything else is broken.

Alex: original curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/payments-v2
# response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":"FF_NO_ACCESS"}
```

ops-bot: JIT approved: JIT-7888. Alex granted ff-auditors-prod role for 60 minutes. Audit id: AUD-2026-03-22-7888

Alex: can confirm access now, pulled audits and saved snapshot. will revert nothing (read-only) and attach audit id to the ticket.

Jordan: nice — when you add the snapshot to the ticket pls include the timestamp + AUD id. if this becomes a recurring job, request a scheduled JIT instead of a service token.

Alex: added snapshot and audit id to the ticket. thanks for the fast help! excited to be on the infra team. :tada:
